about_the_game:
The content added to CUSTOM ORDER MAID 3D2 It's a Night Magic + GP03 by the Tsundere -Prideful and Competitive- DLC can be accessed in the following ways:

1. Harem Wedding

Tsundere can now take part in weddings involving 2 or 4 maids.

You can also play events from the night before the wedding when you try out a new combination of maids.

2. Harem Empire

Tsundere is compatible with the New Yotogi System Harem Yotogi.

You can play 12 different Yotogi skills in combination with scenario events.

Please be advised that this DLC may contain BDSM or BDSM-adjacent content.

-CAUTION-

If you're playing COM3D2 It's a Night Magic without the R-18 patch, you will need update ver. 1.26 to play the "Tsundere ~Prideful and Competitive~" DLC.

Otherwise, Tsundere WILL NOT show up in COM3D2 It's a Night Magic.

Please visit our website and install the update manually.

-Install Instructions-

1. Download update from our website

(It may take awhile to download)

2. Extract the zip folder, and double click the "update.exe" file.
